name: Ancient City of Aleppo
description: Aleppo's old city in northern Syria sits where trade routes have crossed for some 4,000 years, and it grew into a dense maze of narrow alleys, covered souqs, caravanserais and hammams beneath a great hilltop citadel. Its medieval Great Mosque and Ottoman-era mansions made it one of the Middle East's richest historic centres. Around 30% was destroyed in the civil war, and the site is now listed as in danger.
